description: A final class implementing an immutable Label interface with validation for label values.

classes.name: ImmutableLabel
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Label interface encapsulating a label string with validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a Label instance from a CharSequence after validation.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the label string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the label string from start to end indices.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object based on label value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the label value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the label value as a String.
